essence: When the teacher touches the disciple's body, this constitutes touch-initiation.
The utterance of joined mantras is called speech-initiation.
When the teacher properly sees the disciple, this becomes sight-initiation.
The initiation in which knowledge arises immediately is considered śāmbhavī initiation.
The teacher must know the sixfold path and contemplate it in the disciple's body.
